summary: Anthropic's official Claude Platform pricing documentation states under the FAQ 'Are there free tiers or trials?' that new users receive a small amount of free credits to test the API, matching the offer. The exact credit amount is deliberately not published on the page, so no number can be stated; extended trials for enterprise evaluation are available via sales. The get-started docs confirm claiming requires a Claude Console account and an API key. No expiry date or fixed end date for the starter credits is stated, so the offer is treated as ongoing.
claim_steps: New accounts receive a small amount of free credits to test the API (credited to the account; amount not published by Anthropic).
Create an API key in the Console (listed as a prerequisite in the official get-started docs).
Use the API key to make API calls against the free starter credits.
Enterprises needing larger/extended trials for evaluation can contact sales@anthropic.com.
